newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia to pay farmers $1 billion.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia to pay farmers $1 billion.

text.p: Saudi Arabia will next week arrange to pay farmers more than 4 billion riyals ($1 billion) for wheat and barley, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) reported on Sunday.

The kingdom's Finance and National Economy Ministry said in a statement carried by SPA that it will "next week make the necessary arrangements to pay farmers more than 4 billion riyals for wheat and barley supplied in the 1995 season."
The method of payment was not clear.
Saudi Arabia in August started paying more than 3 billion riyals to holders of special farmers certificates on maturity.
The certificates were the first of three tranches of more than nine billion riyals issue this year to meet government arrears up to end-1995 to some 30,000 farmers in the kingdom.
Faced with huge Gulf War liabilities and soft oil prices, Saudi Arabia fell behind on payments to farmers in recent years.
